enGB: Magical Affinity
You become more attuned to magic and can resist spells that should damage you
Combat Prowess
Your physical strength is your best weapon, Your feats of strength make enemies think twice about attacking you reducing their effectiveness against you. You add your strength bonus to everything
Combat Personality
You can avoid attacks via sheer personality. You add your Charisma Bonus to everything
Combat Insight
Your insight into enemy behaviour helps you avoid attacks. You add your Wisdom Bonus to everything
Combat Conditioning
You can feel the flow of the battle and your body is conditioned to take on any attack. You add your Constitution Bonus to everything
Combat Avoidance
They cannot hit you if they cannot get to you. You weave around the battlefield at incredible speed. You add your Dexterity Bonus to everything
Combat Analysis
Your analytic mind makes you see the enemy's moves before they make them. You add your Intelligence Bonus to everything
Mnemonic Device
You have discovered ways to fortify your mind, enabling you to memorise more spells
Magical Affinity (Strength)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your raw physical might, and can resist spells that should damage you
Magical Affinity (Dexterity)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your finely honed reflexes, and can resist spells that should damage you
Magical Affinity (Constitution)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your rugged constitution, and can resist spells that should damage you
Magical Affinity (Intelligence)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your analytical mind, and can resist spells that should damage you
Magical Affinity (Wisdom)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your inner insight, and can resist spells that should damage you
Magical Affinity (Charisma)
You become more attuned to magic, drawing resilience from your force of personality, and can resist spells that should damage you
Advanced Combat Tactics
You have honed a particular approach to combat, drawing on one aspect of yourself to gain an edge in battle
Protective Luck (Effect)
Internal: applied to an attacker to impose disadvantage on their next attack roll against you.
